    Zigzags and crowns #

    A zigzag in a ray category P (Gabriel–Roiter 13.9; Bongartz, Indecomposables live in all smaller lengths, Section 2.1) is a sequence of morphisms (σ₁, ρ₁, σ₂, ρ₂, …) with σᵢ, ρᵢ of common domain and ρᵢ, σᵢ₊₁ of common codomain such that none of σᵢ = ρᵢ ≫ ξ, ρᵢ = σᵢ ≫ ξ, ρᵢ = ξ ≫ σᵢ₊₁, σᵢ₊₁ = ξ ≫ ρᵢ has a solution (diagrammatic order). A crown is a periodic zigzag. A finite ray category containing a zigzag contains a crown (RayCat.exists_crown): some pair (σᵢ, ρᵢ) repeats.
